request.deadline: Period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
deliverables: Set a Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada for Epochs 613-713 as a governance signal.
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period.
Clarify that the limit caps Treasury Withdrawals debited during the period and has no direct on-chain effect.
request.what: Info action to record DRep agreement to a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a new Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for the Cardano Treasury during Epochs 613-713.
The proposed limit caps total ada removed from the Treasury through enacted Treasury Withdrawals during the period and does not count Treasury inflows.
All Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period beginning Epoch 613 count toward the proposed 500,000,000 ada limit.
The action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713 has served as a useful fiscal guardrail but practical room under it is becoming constrained.
A higher 500,000,000 ada limit preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals on their merits while keeping a fixed fiscal guardrail.
The proposer states that the action is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails.
The document asserts that nothing in the Constitution limits DReps to a single Net Change Limit or prevents a newly agreed Net Change Limit from applying to the period.

summary: The document proposes an Info action establishing a 500,000,000 ada Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713, with detailed accounting rules and a claim of constitutional basis, but limited evidence for the practical need to raise the prior 350,000,000 ada limit.
